            cluster_dist[f"cluster_{c}"] = {"pass": pc, "reject": rc, "top_terms": top_terms}

        # Remove zero columns for chi2
        nonzero = contingency.sum(axis=0) > 0
        if nonzero.sum() >= 2:
            chi2_stat, chi2_p, _, _ = stats.chi2_contingency(contingency[:, nonzero])
        else:
            chi2_stat, chi2_p = 0.0, 1.0

        topic_result = {
            "method": f"TF-IDF + KMeans (k={k})",
            "chi2": round(chi2_stat, 4),
            "p": round(chi2_p, 6),
            "clusters": cluster_dist
        }
    except Exception as e:
        topic_result = {"method": "failed", "error": str(e), "chi2": None, "p": None, "clusters": {}}

    print(f"\n--- Topic Clustering ---")
    print(f"Method: {topic_result['method']}")
    print(f"Chi2={topic_result['chi2']}, p={topic_result['p']}")
    for cn, cv in topic_result.get("clusters", {}).items():
        print(f"  {cn}: pass={cv['pass']}, reject={cv['reject']}, terms={cv['top_terms']}")

    # (b) Text statistics
    pass_tok = [len(tokenize_simple(t)) for t in pass_texts]
    reject_tok = [len(tokenize_simple(t)) for t in reject_texts]

    ks_stat, ks_p = stats.ks_2samp(pass_tok, reject_tok) if reject_tok else (0, 1)

    pass_sents = [sentence_split(t) for t in pass_texts]
    reject_sents = [sentence_split(t) for t in reject_texts]

    pass_avg_sent_len = [np.mean([len(tokenize_simple(s)) for s in ss]) if ss else 0 for ss in pass_sents]
    reject_avg_sent_len = [np.mean([len(tokenize_simple(s)) for s in ss]) if ss else 0 for ss in reject_sents]

    mwu_stat, mwu_p = stats.mannwhitneyu(pass_avg_sent_len, reject_avg_sent_len, alternative='two-sided') if reject_avg_sent_len else (0, 1)

    pass_sent_count = [len(ss) for ss in pass_sents]
    reject_sent_count = [len(ss) for ss in reject_sents]
    mwu_sc_stat, mwu_sc_p = stats.mannwhitneyu(pass_sent_count, reject_sent_count, alternative='two-sided') if reject_sent_count else (0, 1)

    token_result = {
        "pass_mean": round(np.mean(pass_tok), 2),
        "pass_std": round(np.std(pass_tok), 2),
        "reject_mean": round(np.mean(reject_tok), 2) if reject_tok else None,
        "reject_std": round(np.std(reject_tok), 2) if reject_tok else None,
        "ks_stat": round(ks_stat, 4),
        "ks_p": round(ks_p, 6)
    }

    sent_len_result = {
        "pass_mean": round(np.mean(pass_avg_sent_len), 2),
        "reject_mean": round(np.mean(reject_avg_sent_len), 2) if reject_avg_sent_len else None,
        "mwu_stat": round(float(mwu_stat), 2),
        "mwu_p": round(float(mwu_p), 6)
    }

    sent_count_result = {
        "pass_mean": round(np.mean(pass_sent_count), 2),
        "reject_mean": round(np.mean(reject_sent_count), 2) if reject_sent_count else None,
        "mwu_stat": round(float(mwu_sc_stat), 2),
        "mwu_p": round(float(mwu_sc_p), 6)
    }

    print(f"\n--- Token Count ---")
    print(f"Pass: {token_result['pass_mean']}±{token_result['pass_std']}, Reject: {token_result['reject_mean']}±{token_result['reject_std']}")
    print(f"KS stat={token_result['ks_stat']}, p={token_result['ks_p']}")

    print(f"\n--- Avg Sentence Length ---")
    print(f"Pass: {sent_len_result['pass_mean']}, Reject: {sent_len_result['reject_mean']}")
    print(f"MWU stat={sent_len_result['mwu_stat']}, p={sent_len_result['mwu_p']}")

    print(f"\n--- Sentence Count ---")
    print(f"Pass: {sent_count_result['pass_mean']}, Reject: {sent_count_result['reject_mean']}")
    print(f"MWU stat={sent_count_result['mwu_stat']}, p={sent_count_result['mwu_p']}")

    # (c) Syntactic complexity via spaCy dependency tree depth
    def get_tree_depth(doc):
        def _depth(token):
            if not list(token.children):
                return 0
            return 1 + max(_depth(c) for c in token.children)
        depths = []
        for sent in doc.sents:

        return depths

    # Process in batches for efficiency; limit text length to avoid OOM

    print(f"Reject depth: {syntax_result['reject_mean']}±{syntax_result['reject_std']}")
    print(f"MWU stat={syntax_result['stat']}, p={syntax_result['p']}")

    result = {
